replacements.before: I'm Trent Sterling (Tront), a game developer with over 15 years of experience, specializing in Unity, C#, and multiplayer networking. I've worked on everything from Minecraft mods to Garry's Mod gamemodes and educational games.
replacements.after: I'm Trent Sterling, usually Tront online. I've been making games since 2009, with most of my work in Unity, C#, and multiplayer networking. I've also worked on mods, educational games, and a growing collection of browser experiments.

replacements.before: Since 2025 I've been the Network Programmer + Unity Generalist on
replacements.after: Since 2025 I've worked as a contract Network Programmer and Unity Generalist on

replacements.before: working in Photon Fusion on Quest and PC VR. On my own stuff I build on Epic Online Services (eos-native: P2P, voice, lobbies, host migration).
replacements.after: using Photon Fusion on Quest and PC VR. For my own projects, I build eos-native on Epic Online Services for P2P networking, voice, lobbies, and host migration.

replacements.before: My focus is on creating solid gameplay, efficient networking, and high-performance VR experiences at 120hz. I also work on shaders and procedural generation.
replacements.after: I spend a lot of time on how games feel, what they send over the network, and how much work they ask of the GPU. That takes me into gameplay systems, VR optimization, shaders, and procedural generation.

replacements.before: smooth, immersive VR at 120Hz+, Quest + PC VR.
replacements.after: Quest and PC VR, including work toward 120Hz+ performance targets.

replacements.before: I started with Halo CE/2 modding and later worked on Minecraft mods and Garry's Mod gamemodes. These early experiences taught me game mechanics, scripting, and community-driven development.
replacements.after: I started with Halo CE/2 modding, then Minecraft mods and Garry's Mod gamemodes. Working on games people could change and play together got me into scripting, game mechanics, and community development.

replacements.before: I've since focused on indie game development and multiplayer games, especially VR performance optimization and network traffic optimization for smoother gameplay.
replacements.after: That led me into indie games and multiplayer work, and eventually VR.

replacements.before: Production work, games, experiments, and tools by Trent Sterling (Tront), Network Programmer and Unity Generalist on Project Demigod. Building in Unity, C#, VR, multiplayer, and GPU systems since 2009. Most of the browser games here are one self-contained HTML file: nothing to install, nothing to download.
replacements.after: These are games I've worked on and tools I've built, from my contract work on Project Demigod to multiplayer experiments and weekend prototypes. Many run straight in your browser. For the development notes, see my blog; the public code is on GitHub.

replacements.before: Leave a mark. Grab a dummy, slam it, and drag it through blood that stays. A physics playground with contact smears, wall splashes, and dripping stains.
replacements.after: Grab a dummy, slam it, and drag it through blood that stays. This physics playground leaves contact smears, wall splashes, and dripping stains behind.

replacements.before: 3.2 km. One good line. Chain downhill landings, collect burst charge and beat your personal best through Sunfall Causeway. A browser momentum runner inspired by HASTE.
replacements.after: A browser momentum runner inspired by HASTE. Chain downhill landings and collect burst charge across the 3.2 km Sunfall Causeway to beat your personal best.

replacements.before: A little ocean. A big empire. Feed a shoal into a ridiculous aquarium economy, protect the nursery, fight the Broodship, hatch the Crown Fish. Then keep your empire.
replacements.after: Feed your shoal and grow a ridiculous aquarium economy while protecting the nursery. Fight the Broodship, hatch the Crown Fish, and keep building your empire afterward.

replacements.before: A little forest. A very busy axe. Sweep a giant axe over a floating island and fell the grove in one swoop: pumpkin blasts, chain lightning, busy beavers. Then axe it all again tomorrow.
replacements.after: Sweep a giant axe across a floating island, with pumpkin blasts, chain lightning, and busy beavers helping you fell the grove. There is always more to chop tomorrow.

replacements.before: Shared ink. Bad landings. Draw tracks in ink, ride them, crash beautifully. A physics sketchbook you can play alone or in a room where everyone draws and rides the same sheet.
replacements.after: Draw tracks in ink and try to ride them without crashing. Play this physics sketchbook alone or join a room where everyone draws and rides on the same sheet.

replacements.before: Small tanks. Big grudges. Turn-based artillery with destructible terrain and 400 wild weapons: quick battles against the CPU, hot-seat, or online with a public quick join.
replacements.after: Turn-based tank artillery with destructible terrain and 400 wild weapons. Play a quick battle against the CPU, share a hot-seat game, or use public quick join to play online.

replacements.before: Just a bunch of tiny zombies. A Unity horde experiment from the winter of 2014.
replacements.after: Just a bunch of tiny zombies. A Unity horde experiment.

replacements.before: Cyberpunk hacking game in VR: jack into systems, navigate virtual spaces, avoid ICE. Neon grids and data streams on Quest 2.
replacements.after: HackerPunk is a multiplayer VR shooter with vehicles, weapons, spatial voice chat, and hookshot grappling in a cyberpunk world.

replacements.before: Top-down co-op zombie escape. Four survivors, huge hordes, smart AI squadmates, one red safehouse door. Play online with whoever is there or share a room code with friends.
replacements.after: Guide four survivors through zombie hordes to a safehouse in this top-down co-op game, with AI squadmates fighting alongside you. You can play with whoever is online or share a room code with friends.

replacements.before: First-person sequel to my 2015 jam mining game. Dig beneath your backyard, sell what you find, upgrade the cutter, follow the signal deeper. Early prototype.
replacements.after: This early first-person prototype follows up on my 2015 jam mining game. Dig beneath your backyard, sell what you find, and upgrade your cutter as you follow a signal deeper underground.

replacements.before: Tower defense against 100,000 zombies simulated as a fluid, entirely on GPU compute. Giants, lasers, WebGPU right in the browser.
replacements.after: This browser tower-defense prototype uses WebGPU compute to simulate 100,000 zombies as a fluid, with giants and lasers in the mix.

replacements.before: 6DOF procedural mine crawler. Descend through biomes hunting keycards, dodging hazards, managing shield and energy.
replacements.after: Explore procedural mines with six degrees of freedom as you search for keycards across different biomes, avoid hazards, and manage your shield and energy.

replacements.before: Cozy multiplayer hangout around a campfire. P2P peer sync, procedural critters, WASD to walk, chat, and pet the wildlife.
replacements.after: Hang out around a multiplayer campfire, chat with other players, and pet the procedural wildlife. It uses peer-to-peer synchronization, with WASD controls for walking.

replacements.before: The front row is ammo. Sidestep a swing, bank discs off the wall, and turn the next hit into a chain reaction. Play a five-round run, try builds in Sandbox, or test your browser with eight honest benchmarks.
replacements.after: Use the front row as ammo, dodge swings, and bank discs off walls to set off chain reactions in a five-round run. Sandbox mode lets you try different builds, and eight benchmarks let you test browser performance.

replacements.before: Paint emitters and surfaces, explore soft shadows, and inspect the math behind a highlight. Seven interactive scenes, contextual editors, and ray-tested comparisons, based on LTC research.
replacements.after: Explore soft shadows and highlights by painting emitters and surfaces across seven interactive scenes. Contextual editors and ray-tested comparisons let you inspect the math behind the LTC lighting research.

replacements.before: Outnumbered? Send dudes. Hold the core through three sieges, turn kills into reinforcements, unlock Titans. 200,000 fighters simulated on the GPU, blood that stays on the ground. WebGPU.
replacements.after: Defend the core through three sieges by turning kills into reinforcements and unlocking Titans. The WebGPU simulation handles 200,000 fighters and leaves blood on the ground.

replacements.before: The city is ammunition. Voxel destruction sandbox: grab a building with the God Hand, rip it off its supports and throw it through the one next door. Rockets, bomb rain, real rigid-body collapses.
replacements.after: Use the God Hand to tear buildings off their supports and throw them into their neighbors in this voxel destruction sandbox. Rockets and bomb rain give you more ways to bring the rigid-body structures down.

replacements.before: Multiplayer ragdoll sandbox. Grab a limb, wind up, let go. One shared room, four players over WebRTC, 31 tools, and one Buddy who never learns.
replacements.after: Up to four players can join a shared WebRTC room and use 31 tools to grab, swing, and fling Buddy around in this ragdoll sandbox. After all that, Buddy still never learns.

replacements.before: Vector materials for voxel blocks: contours in data textures, evaluated in the shader. Zoom forever, no bitmap blur.
replacements.after: This voxel-material experiment stores contours in data textures and evaluates them in the shader, so the surfaces stay sharp as you zoom in rather than blurring like a bitmap.

replacements.before: Streamed Surface Nets terrain sandbox. Carve and build in the same frame, plant forests, wake volcanoes, dig up a fossil.
replacements.after: Carve and build streamed Surface Nets terrain in the same frame, plant forests, wake volcanoes, and dig up fossils in this sandbox.

replacements.before: Video, MP3, or both. Pick a quality and folder in a compact Rust app with custom window chrome, editable themes, and bundled download tools. One portable Windows EXE.
replacements.after: Save videos, MP3 audio, or both with a compact Rust app that lets you choose the quality and destination folder. It includes editable themes, custom window chrome, and bundled download tools in one portable Windows executable.

replacements.before: Bit-packed splat maps in WebGL2: blending 32+ terrain textures through one sampler. Tutorial + live demo.
replacements.after: This tutorial and live WebGL2 demo show how bit-packed splat maps let you blend 32 or more terrain textures through one sampler.

replacements.before: Procedural creature sandbox: primitive shapes fused into seamless toon critters by an SDF blend-shell vertex shader. Walks, hops, flies, all procedural.
replacements.after: Build creatures from primitive shapes that an SDF blend-shell vertex shader joins into a seamless toon body. Their walking, hopping, and flight are procedural too.

replacements.before: 3D browser farming game with Animal Crossing world curvature. Procedural textures and audio, click-to-play farming, auto-save.
replacements.after: Grow a farm in a 3D browser game with click-to-play controls and an Animal Crossing-style curved world. It uses procedural textures and audio, and saves your progress automatically.

replacements.before: A fast disk space visualizer inspired by SpaceMonger. Squarified treemaps, smooth camera, lazy LOD. Built with Rust + egui. Single portable .exe.
replacements.after: Explore disk usage through squarified treemaps, with a smooth camera and lazy level-of-detail rendering. Inspired by SpaceMonger, SpaceView is built with Rust and egui and runs as a single portable Windows executable.

replacements.before: Cozy farming sim in VR: plant, water, harvest and sell with your own hands. Stardew Valley meets Quest. Never reached a releasable state.
replacements.after: Plant, water, harvest, and sell crops with your own hands in a Quest farming sim inspired by Stardew Valley. I never got it to a releasable state.

replacements.before: VR brawler on Quest 2. You punch dudes, they ragdoll. Physics-based combat that never stops being satisfying.
replacements.after: Punch dudes and watch them ragdoll in this physics-based VR brawler for Quest 2.
